scope: Ordinary Firebird execution evidence. Final ordinary and optional debug interactions have separate receipts; wrapper completion and observed gameplay are reported separately.

method.nand: Disposable copies of the owner-provided original NAND. The original NAND is unchanged. Only known old application files were removed from the disposable copy to make room for the test package.
method.transfer: Regular emulator USB put/get operations. A previously verified canonical run save and eight-byte preference file were imported as files for the final compatibility route; no process memory or emulator snapshot was imported.

observed: Fresh ordinary OS boot and successful ordinary Ndless installer.
Final resources and ordinary launcher transferred over USB; launcher read back exactly.
Documents launch reaches Chinese language chooser and then the title.
Continue opens the imported Ironclad Neow save with HP 80/80, gold 99 and deck count 10.
G does not open a developer menu in the ordinary build; Esc opens the actual pause overlay.
The actual Settings overlay displays restored Fast Mode as checked after a full gear-animation interval.
Save and Exit returns to the title with Continue available; Exit confirmation returns to the ordinary OS Documents browser.
Ordinary USB readback after exit matches the original 230112-byte canonical save exactly and preserves the eight-byte Fast Mode preference.
The controller saves the disposable flash and quits cleanly; the command journal returns 0 with unchanged frozen source.
The final optional debug launcher is USB-read back exactly and launched through OS/Documents.
G opens the fourteen-preset menu with menu-only calculator instructions and no unavailable I text editor.
The ordinary monster-room preset opens an actual battle with enemy HP 45 and player energy 3/3.
Keyboard select/aim uses the original curved red targeting textures; the second Confirm plays Strike, reducing enemy HP 45 to 39 and player energy 3 to 2.
The kill-all preset executes death/reward hooks and reaches the original-styled loot screen with gold 14 and a card reward.
The shop preset reaches the merchant with corrected atlas orientation; the actual inventory displays items within the rug.
An ordinary card purchase changes gold 99 to 13 and deck count 10 to 11.
O reloads the unchanged original Neow save, restoring gold 99 and deck count 10. The debug commands and purchase had not autosaved that original run.
capture_label_corrections: merchant-inventory-stage8 captured the still-closed shop before its cold frame completed; it is not evidence of the open inventory.
debug-rest-stage8 actually captured the open merchant inventory after a card purchase. It is not evidence that the rest-room command succeeded.
final_debug_observations.limit: The wrapper reached its wall deadline after these observations, before ordinary exit and final readback. These observed features do not turn the entire timed-out wrapper into a passed run.
final_debug_observations.runtime_identity_note: The interactive wrapper started from the stage-7 source archive. Its unchanged ordinary controller then uploaded the stage-8 debug launcher at simulated 37360 ms and USB-read it back at 38800 ms before the recorded final gameplay. The wrapper source identity and the subsequently executed launcher identity are intentionally reported separately.

retained_prior_runs.runtime_scope: Earlier stage-4/5/6 progression; final ordinary execution in this session was stage 6, not stage 8.
retained_prior_runs.observed: Ordinary boot/install/launch, settings toggle and persistence, actual Save and Exit, relaunch/Continue, normal G exclusion and byte-identical canonical save after Continue. The controller flushed and quit cleanly.

retained_prior_runs.failure: On a reused disposable flash, the ordinary Ndless installer entered the emulator debugger with PC invalid 1178ae80 at simulated 20810 ms. The final game did not execute in that attempt.
retained_prior_runs.cause: Undetermined. The earlier wrapper timeout and this later installer failure are retained as distinct outcomes; no causal relationship is asserted.

interpretation: Original-game UI sources guide implementation, but these emulator observations are not complete original-PC pixel or timing parity.
ARM build/allocation checks, native/WASM agreement, browser storage acceptance and host benchmarks retain their separate evidence scopes.
No emulator elapsed interval is reported as physical-calculator FPS.
No rest-room success is claimed from the mislabeled debug capture; that room is covered separately by native/WASM/browser regression evidence.
